claim: Pilot: KAN head sensitivity to grid_size (3 vs 5 vs 8) and spline_order, to test the expressiveness-versus-parameters trade-off and identify the best KAN head for the full evaluation
hypothesis: H2: increasing KAN grid_size/spline_order raises prediction-head parameters and expressiveness but with diminishing returns / possible overfitting on the 48-step BIKE head.
notes: Pilot runs feed the selection of the full-evaluation KAN config. Negative/diminishing results are preserved in experiments/negative_registry.csv.
